cohort: A total of 353 mothers (118 cases and 235 controls) receiving labor care at three public hospitals in Northeast Ethiopia participated in the study.
finding: Previous caesarian section, history of abortion, history of premature membrane rupture, chronic cough, mid-upper arm circumference < 23 cm, suspected sepsis, and urinary tract infection were significantly associated with premature membrane rupture.
mod_finding: A previous caesarian section was identified as a determinant of premature membrane rupture.
